args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy — rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in all three production regions with an ~18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was only ever healthy in staging).
2. **Rolled back** all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0.
3. **Verified** recovery: all regions now on v2.3.0, healthy, error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` documenting the failed deploy, the rollback, and the recovered state. On-call has been paged.
